title: P15.9-A1 R3c: entity-key enumeration — raw objective_id alias bypass closed
description: R3b residual on PR #91 (BASE e24e334); R1/R2/R3 preserved. businessCompany previously enumerated objectives.list() and called objectives.get(o.objective_id) on the raw payload claim: rewriting OBJ_B.payload.objective_id to OBJ_A made get fetch the victim row twice and the forged row was never validated. Now enumeration runs through store.entityPage (proves persisted entity_id key == payload.entity_id == payload_hash == version), every actual stored row is strict-read by its PROVEN key via objectives.get, and the row's claimed objective_id must equal that key — a payload identity alias fails closed even with a recomputed digest. Scope: org-wide fail-closed (documented). Adversarial tests: objective_id alias to victim, forged entity_id, plus all prior R1-R3 negatives. Tests 28/28; regressions 211; tsc+build+verify:change READY. No authority-semantics change; no UI/A2; no CEO/Router/Executor/KPI/Telegram. No merge/deploy.
